support.quote: While Canada is not home to "more lakes than the rest of the world combined" like some social media posts claim, it has more lakes than any other individual country.

assessments.note: 'more than half of all natural lakes' holds only for lakes of 10 ha or more (HydroLAKES: 863,550 in Canada of ~1.42 million); counting smaller lakes the share is far lower. Wording and body narrowed to lakes of 10 ha+.
